abstract: A 36-year-old man presented with cognitive impairment and disturbance of short-term memory functions with character change. Cerebrospinal fluid analysis revealed no abnormalities; however, brain MRI revealed high-signal intensity from bilateral hippocampus lesions on fluid attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) images and T(2) weighted images. The 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose PET demonstrated high glucose uptake in the bilateral hippocampus lesions. He was diagnosed as limbic encephalitis, and was administered high-dose intravenous methylprednisolone and immune adsorption plasma therapy followed by intravenous immunoglobulin therapy. MRI abnormalities improved after treatment but recent memory disturbance remained. Ma2 antibody, NMDA-receptor antibody, and GluRε2 antibody were positive. Eleven months atter the onset of disease, the tumor was identified in left testicle by ultrasound and removed the tumor. The pathological findings were seminoma. We experienced a case of paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis associated with seminoma with short-term memory disturbance. The occurrence of paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis with antibodies against cell membrane (NMDA-receptor antibody and GluRε2 antibody) and intracellular (Ma2 antibody) is rare even in the literature.
abstract_ja: 36歳男性が認知機能障害と短期記憶機能障害、性格変化を呈した。脳脊髄液検査に異常はなかったが、脳MRIではFLAIR像およびT2強調像で両側海馬に高信号病変を認めた。18F-フルオロデオキシグルコースPETでは両側海馬病変に高い糖取り込みを認めた。辺縁系脳炎と診断され、大量メチルプレドニゾロン静注療法と免疫吸着療法、続いて静注免疫グロブリン療法が施行された。治療後にMRI異常は改善したが、近時記憶障害は残存した。抗Ma2抗体、抗NMDA受容体抗体、抗GluRε2抗体が陽性であった。発症11か月後に、超音波検査で左精巣に腫瘍が同定され、切除された。病理所見はセミノーマであった。我々は、短期記憶障害を伴うセミノーマに関連した腫瘍随伴性辺縁系脳炎の症例を経験した。細胞膜抗体(抗NMDA受容体抗体、抗GluRε2抗体)と細胞内抗体(抗Ma2抗体)を伴う腫瘍随伴性辺縁系脳炎の発生は、文献上も稀である。
